newsitem.title: USA: States file suits against Vacation Break.
newsitem.headline: States file suits against Vacation Break.

text.p: Vacation Break USA Inc said on Friday that attorneys general in certain states had filed lawsuits against the company, alleging deceptive marketing practices of vacation packages.
The actions seek damages from the company and changes in the company's marketing practices, the company said.
Vacation Break was not immediately available to say what states had filed the actions.

Vacation Break said it has always attempted to comply with all federal and state laws and regulations that pertain to the sales of vacation packages. Also, the company said it has been negotiating with a number of states to resolve any disputes.
"However, in the event that settlement efforts are unsuccessful, we are prepared to vigorously defend our business practices," president Kevin Sheehan said in a statement.
None of the complaints allege that Vacation Break has violated any federal statutes or regulations, the company said.
